relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these data demonstrate that local inhibition of CGRP within CSF-contacting nucleus blocks the CGRP-RAMP1-PKA signaling cascade, thereby attenuating TN-associated pain.

relationships.subject: Trigeminal neuralgia
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting that the TN surgery activated a local CGRP-RAMP1-PKA signaling cascade in this region

relationships.subject: CSF-contacting nucleus
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of the CSF-contacting nucleus in normal rats induces hyperalgesia, while inhibition in TN rats significantly alleviates pain.

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis revealed that olcegepant markedly decreased RAMP1 and p-PKA protein levels in the CSF-contacting nucleus of TN rats

key_findings: In ION-CCI trigeminal neuralgia rats, CGRP, RAMP1 and p-PKA are upregulated in the CSF-contacting nucleus, which is activated (c-Fos) and drives hyperalgesia.
RAMP1 knockdown or olcegepant attenuates pain; the knockdown effect is reversed by cAMP.
